facts.value: Law enforcement, public order, crime investigation, and traffic regulation across Lebanon.
Emergency/police hotline: 112. Official contact page also lists headquarters phones 01/422000 and 01/425250, email isf@isf.gov.lb, and service number 1745.
facts.notes: Verified on official ISF contact page on 2026-05-24. Do not treat 999 as primary without a current official source.

facts.value: NOT responsible for civic infrastructure (roads, water, waste). Public safety threats, armed persons, criminal activity are ISF scope.

Call 112 for emergencies. ISF commissariats handle non-emergency reports. ISF Information Department receives confidential complaints/tips through intelligence@isfid.gov.lb and free hotline 1788. Cybercrime/online blackmail can be reported to 01 293293 or the ISF Anonymous Complaints form. HITL always required when CedarFix routes to ISF.
Nationwide. Organized by commissariat regions across all governorates.
Immediate dispatch for criminal/armed threats. No published SLA for non-emergency complaints.

hitl_conditions: All ISF routing requires HITL — never auto-route criminal/safety matters
Civil Defense also involved if injuries/rescues required alongside ISF scene
